title: Keyturn Guest Protection Plan: The Fee an Additional Driver Carries
content:
An additional driver is taken onto the protection covering a trip one driver at a time, and what that driver
costs is settled for the whole of that trip rather than day by day.

The fee for an additional driver on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election is the level's additional driver
fee, taken in full for the whole of the election's covered days, and the amount is rounded half up to the cent
only once the whole of it has been worked out.

| The level the election stands on | The additional driver fee |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 25.00 USD |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 22.00 USD |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 20.00 USD |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 18.00 USD |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 0.00 USD |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 0.00 USD |

## The same rule put as a question the schedule answers

**What does a second driver cost on a trip of four days?** The level's additional driver fee, taken in full.
**And on a trip of forty days?** The same figure: the fee is settled for the whole of the trip and not by the
day, so the length of the election's covered days does not multiply it.

## Worked on hypothetical elections

An election on Keyturn Standard Protection carrying 6 days of cover takes that level's additional driver fee of
20.00 USD in full, and the figure is rounded half up to the cent once it has been worked out, giving 20.00 USD
for the driver.

An election on Keyturn Minimum Protection carrying 21 days of cover takes 22.00 USD; an election on Keyturn
Declined Protection carrying 3 days of cover takes 25.00 USD. An election on Keyturn Premier Protection or on
Keyturn Business Traveler Protection takes 0.00 USD however many days the election carries and however many
drivers are approved on it.
